description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" measured across various language families for six different morphosyntactic probing models. The horizontal axis represents the categorical variable "family," displaying nine language groups arranged in alphabetical order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the "effect" value on a linear scale, with a visible range extending from slightly below 0 to over 30, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30) and corresponding horizontal grid lines. A small gray shaded rectangle is visible on the y-axis between the values of 20 and 25. Within each language family category on the horizontal axis, the data is visually arranged into groups of six adjacent bars, each corresponding to a specific model as indicated by the legend. The models and their assigned colors are mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). All bars feature black outlines and are overlaid with black, capped error bars. The bar heights vary significantly across categories and models; for instance, the tallest bar represents mBERT-B₂ in the IE-Indic category with an approximate value of 25, while the shortest bars are found in the Isolate and Uralic categories, where all models show values near zero. Additionally, some bars extend below the zero line, such as the mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ models in the Semitic category, which have approximate values of -2 and -1, respectively.
